info.title: ROSE Flower Shop API
info.description: Generated from the audited source. See API_DOCUMENTATION.md for conventions, error format, rate limits and Socket.IO events.

post.description: Access: Public. 201 {user}. Role is always `customer`. 409 if e-mail exists. Rate limited.

post.summary: Apply as a florist (pending admin approval)
post.description: Access: Public. 201 {user} with floristStatus=PENDING.
Access: Public. 200 {token, user}. 401 "Invalid Email or Password" for unknown e-mail or wrong password; 403 if deactivated. Rate limited per IP and per e-mail (429).

post.summary: Log out (invalidates all tokens of the user)
post.description: Access: Any logged-in user. 200.

patch.description: Access: Any logged-in user. At least one field. Other fields are ignored.
Access: Any logged-in user. 200 {token} (a new token; all old tokens are invalidated). 401 wrong current password; 422 if same.

get.description: Access: Public. 200 {items, pagination}. Hides florist, recipe, reservedQuantity, approval fields.

post.description: Access: Admin. 201 {product}. Slug is generated.

get.description: Access: Public. 404 if inactive or not approved.
Access: Public. 200 {items, distribution, pagination}. Reviewer shown by first name only.

patch.description: Access: Admin. Stock, slug, ratings and sold count cannot be set here.

schema.description: any of: title, description, category, price, discountPrice, sizes, tags, occasions, images, recipe, lowStockThreshold, isFeatured, isActive, florist (nullable)

patch.description: Access: Admin. 409 if below the reserved amount.

patch.summary: Approve or reject a florist product

post.description: Access: Admin. 409 if name exists.
Access: Customer. 409 if over available stock; 422 if total > 100.

patch.description: Access: Customer. 404 if not in cart.

post.description: Access: Customer. 201 {order}. Prices, discount, delivery fee (40 EGP) and total are computed server-side. Stock is reserved. 409 on insufficient stock or unavailable coupon.

items.description: [{productId, quantity: int 1-50, size?: Standard|Deluxe|Premium, cardMessage?: <=300, wrappingNote?: <=300}] 1-30

delivery.description: {recipientName 2-80, recipientPhone, addressLine1 3-200, addressLine2?, city 2-80, postalCode?, country?: 2 letters, deliveryDate: ISO date not in the past, slot: 09:00-12:00|12:00-15:00|15:00-18:00|18:00-21:00, notes?: <=300}

get.description: Access: Customer (own) or Admin. Customers see only their own (404 otherwise). Admin sees full detail incl. customer and florist.

patch.description: Access: Customer (own) or Admin. Customer: only PLACED or CONFIRMED. Releases stock/coupon; paid ONLINE orders are refunded. 409 otherwise.

get.description: Access: Approved florist. Fulfilment projection only (no customer, address or prices).

patch.description: Access: Approved florist. Only on orders assigned to the caller.
Access: Admin. Transitions: PLACED→CONFIRMED|CANCELLED, CONFIRMED→PREPARING|CANCELLED, PREPARING→READY|CANCELLED, READY→OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY→DELIVERED. Otherwise 409.
Access: Admin. 409 for COD, cancelled, refunded orders, or PAID→FAILED.

post.summary: Start a Stripe payment for an ONLINE order
post.description: Access: Customer. 201 {paymentId, clientSecret, amount, currency}. Idempotent per order. 403 not your order; 409 already paid.

get.description: Access: Owner or Admin. Owner or admin (403 otherwise). Client secret is never returned.

post.description: Access: Admin. 400 if above refundable amount; 409 if not refundable.

Access: Stripe signature. Header `Stripe-Signature` required (400 otherwise). Handles payment_intent.succeeded, payment_intent.payment_failed, charge.refunded. Duplicate and out-of-order events are ignored. Not for client use.

post.summary: Preview a coupon against the cart
post.description: Access: Customer. 200 {code, discountType, discountValue, subtotal, discount, subtotalAfterDiscount}. 400 if invalid, expired, used up or below minimum.
Access: Admin. 409 if code exists.

schema.description: any of the create fields except code

delete.description: Access: Admin. 409 if already used; deactivate instead.

post.description: Access: Customer. Only for DELIVERED orders containing the product. 409 if already reviewed.

get.description: Access: Customer (own) or Admin. Owner or admin.

post.summary: Mark helpful (one vote, not your own)
post.description: Access: Customer. 409 if own or already voted.

get.summary: Is the product in the wishlist

post.description: Access: Customer. 201. 409 if present.

get.description: Access: Any florist. Available to pending and rejected florists.

schema.description: bio?, specialties?, yearsExperience?, shiftStart?, shiftEnd? (HH:MM), avatar?: url

put.description: Access: Any florist. 409 once approved. Resets status to PENDING.

get.description: Access: Approved florist. All endpoints below require an approved florist.

post.description: Access: Approved florist. 201.

schema.description: same fields as admin create, without isFeatured/isActive/florist

patch.description: Access: Approved florist. 403 if changing price/sizes of an approved product.

get.summary: Read-only ingredients used by own products
get.description: Access: Approved florist. No cost or supplier data.

post.summary: Open a ticket to the admin team
post.description: Access: Customer or Florist. 201. Limited to 10 per hour.

get.description: Access: Customer or Florist. Staff identity is hidden; admin replies appear as `support`.

post.description: Access: Customer or Florist. Re-opens a resolved ticket; 409 if closed. 20 per minute.

get.description: Access: Any logged-in user. 200 {items, pagination}. Each item has lastMessage and unreadCount.

get.summary: Messages visible to the caller's side
get.description: Access: Any logged-in user. 404 for conversations you are not part of.

delete.description: Access: Any logged-in user. Admin gets 204.

post.summary: Send a message to the bot
post.description: Access: Customer. 201 {sessionId, status, reply:{body, intent, payload, confidence}}. Intents: SUPPORT (hands off to a human chat), ORDER_STATUS, PRODUCT_SEARCH, RECOMMENDATION, FAQ, then optional LLM fallback. 20 per minute.
Access: Customer. 404 if none.
Access: Admin.

schema.description: name?, type?, unit?, lowStockThreshold?, costPerUnit?, supplier?, isActive?

patch.description: Access: Admin. 409 if a negative delta exceeds stock.

schema.description: exactly one of: delta (non-zero number) | quantity (absolute >=0)

get.description: Access: Admin. Logs are kept one year.

patch.description: Access: Admin. department only changeable by the owner.

schema.description: department?, title?, bio?, avatar?, phone?, notifyOnLowStock?, notifyOnNewOrder?, notifyOnNegativeReview?

patch.description: Access: Admin. 409 for self; 403 for the owner admin; cannot remove the last admin; a florist with active orders cannot be changed. Invalidates the user's tokens.
Access: Admin. Invalidates tokens. Not self, not owner, not last admin.

post.description: Access: Admin. 201.

schema.description: name; email; password; phone; businessName?; licenseNumber?; businessAddress?; bio?; specialties?
bio?, specialties?, yearsExperience?, shiftStart?, shiftEnd?, isAvailable?

post.summary: Open a ticket to a customer or florist
post.description: Access: Admin.
Access: Admin.
